alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued August 15 at 4:11AM EDT until August 15 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Portions of north central Maryland, northwest Virginia,
and eastern West Virginia.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM EDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.area: Washington; Shenandoah; Frederick; Page; Warren; Clarke; Morgan; Berkeley; Jefferson; Hardy; Eastern Grant

alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 15 at 3:35AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.description:
Patchy dense fog is developing in the river valleys, and will
persist through early this morning. Motorists should exercise
extra caution, reduce speed, allow extra travel time and following
distance, and use low beam headlights.
